reviews.title: Quiet, High quality, wires match PSU color
reviews.comment: Incredible quality, feels like you're holding a space ship part. Cables come in the same color, as the power supply itself. Noises are minimal to zero. Absolutely gorgeous piece of electronic.
reviews.author: TOMMY

reviews.title: Good, modular, all the features needed in SFX
reviews.comment: Good product. Running a i7 & 4060 slim in a media center setup and keeps its cool at 100% GPU and CPU utilization.
reviews.author: Mark

reviews.title: Is hawt, but solid
reviews.comment:
Seems to be keeping up with an EVGA (RIP) 3080 FTW and i7 10700. Not flexing, just suggesting that 750w is keeping up just fine...so far.
Does run warm when going full tilt, so make sure your case/placement against walls isn't too tight, it needs to breath.
reviews.author: Liam
